item.title: Shamanic Full Moon Ceremony — Wed Jul 29, 7:30 PM
item.description:
Awakening Asheville **Come and join us for an (outside) full Moon ceremony commemorating this month’s Buck moon.**
**I will invite the spirits and guides to join us. We will have a comfortable meditation and some manifestations and intention setting for the new moon cycle.**
**We will participate in a healing journey which is very powerful and quite healing.**
**We will be sharing and discussing some thought-provoking questions. I recommend bringing a journal to record your thoughts.**
**We can share some stories around the fire and then I will close the ceremony.**
**Bring appropriate crystals that you would like charged. The best crystals to charge during a full moon are amethyst, smoky quartz, citrine, black selenite, and obsidian. We will be outside so please dress for the weather.**
**This is a laid-back event at our home, I hope that you can join us.**
**Plenty of parking available, but you will need a gate code coming in the community.**
**See you then!** **Shaman Phil**

item.title: MTS Trail North Out-and-Back, 6 mi. 600ft. Elev. Gain — Fri Jul 31, 9:00 AM
item.description:
The Asheville Hiking Group **[Sign-up opens Sunday evening 7/26 @ 8:00 PM]**
**[Note: Same meeting place & time as last week, but we'll go north on the MST rather than South.}**
This is a simple, relatively mild hike on the Mountain-to-Sea Trail, 3 miles North followed by 3 miles back to the starting point. Our pace will be faster than a casual stroll, slower than a fitness hike -- around 2.4-2.5 mph.
We'll take a 15-minute break at the turnaround point.
Dogs are welcome, but they must be leashed in accordance with Forest Service regulations.
**MEETING TIME & DIRECTIONS**
We'll gather at 9:00 AM on the south side of the Fresh Market parking lot in front of the Haywood Appliance store. The address is 1378 Hendersonville Rd. Look for me at my silver Hyundai.
Link for Google Maps: [Fresh Market Parking Lot](https://maps.app.goo.gl/VBNrrBeuUSnLeU3j6)
We set out by **9:05**.

item.title: Camino de Brevard w/ WNC Pilgrims — Sat Aug 1, 9:00 AM
item.description:
The Asheville Hiking Group **Overview:** This hike is offered as a monthly training hike with the WNC Asheville Chapter of the association of American Pilgrims on the Camino. The route has been announced on the WNC Camino Group [Facebook Group Page](https://www.facebook.com/groups/AVLCamino/announcements).
**Distance:** 4, 8, or 11 miles **Elevation Gain:** 600 ft in small chunks **Surface:** Road **Pace: 3.2 mph** **Dogs:** Well-behaved dogs on leash. **Gear:** Water, sunscreen, snacks, cash / payment method for the farmer's market.
**Origin of Route:** This route was created by Kacey R for the WNC Chapter of the American Society of Pilgrims on the Camino.
**All Trails Route Map:** [Brevard Camino Route](https://www.alltrails.com/explore/custom-routes/brevard-camino-k-ratterjee-568e974?u=i&sh=ifwm3x) The route has 3 sections, each about 4 miles long. Choose the distance that works for you!

item.description: Bio At its core, The Moon and You is a charismatic husband-and-wife team. Melissa Hyman plays cello, Ryan Furstenberg plays guitar and banjo, and both sing in “voices that sound like they were made for one another” (Bill DeYoung, Connect Savannah). But whatever you might assume based on their gorgeous vocal blend and heartfelt lyrics, this ain’t your basic folk duo. With a rotating cast of talented friends to add unexpected instrumentation to their lineup, The Moon and You never plays the same show twice. This ever-evolving, expandable and collapsible model leaves the band constantly reinventing itself in ways both surprising and satisfying. item.title: Ginger's Revenge presents: "Sit a Spell" - Traditional Music Sessions with Warren Wilson College — Fri Aug 7, 6:00 PM — Ginger's Revenge
item.description:
Ginger's Revenge Craft Brewery & Tasting Room and Warren Wilson College are teaming up to launch “Sit a Spell,” a new weekly traditional music jam that will raise funds for the Warren Wilson Music Scholarship Fund while bringing together Asheville’s vibrant roots music community.
The open jam sessions will take place Fridays from 6–8 p.m., beginning April 3, at Ginger’s Revenge’s Tasting Room at 829 Riverside Drive, Suite 100. Musicians of all levels are welcome to bring instruments and join the circle, while community members are invited to come listen and enjoy an evening of traditional music. Musical genres will rotate weekly, highlighting a variety of traditions and styles. There will be four Warren Wilson College faculty members who will rotate hosting each week:

item.description:
Create your own mixed media art piece with Julia Briggs. Julia will demonstrate how to use ink and block printing mixed with the warm texture of embroidery stitches and fabric to create a diverse art piece. Julia Briggs is a multi-media, poly-lingual visual artist. She teaches art and design in New York, New Jersey, and North Carolina. She has a worldly art education which started in her home-town of Sao Paulo, Brazil. After majoring in Fine Arts and Art History in NYC, she continues to practice her art and teaches various mediums. Her passion for art and design comes from a philosophy of “lived in beauty”, and encourages students to travel, be creative thinkers, surround themselves with things they have made, and focus on beautiful, quality design.
